_doc: LANCE-19 batch 3: Light Wheeled APC (RGriffin65) as the armoured car; 2 axles, front steers.
notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 3, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in armoredcar_veh.json). The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (armoredcar_prep.json). The wheels (`wheel_l0`..) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheels, which were cut from the hull; this own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 3 degrees, collapse only above 80k faces a part (no collapse on the shell-soup Hunter route; these hulls are clean). WHEELED, 2 axles. The front pair is under `steer_l0`/`steer_r0`. No turret or gun: the original's two weapon nodes sit on the hull front and the data gives max_turret_yaw 0.
